card.name: Ends of dose and diagnostics words
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word like dose or diagnostics in drug-label text, mostly in the FDA CompanionDiagnostics web link and in 'FTC dose' during dialysis.

modes.label: FDA diagnostics link
modes.description: The second half of 'Diagnostics' inside the fda.gov companion diagnostics address.

modes.label: Dose after a drug name or 'Lower'
modes.description: The word dose or doses in sentences about removal by dialysis or adjusting other drugs.
modes.example: Hemodialysis treatment removes approximately 30% of the FTC<< dose>> over a 3-hour dialysis period

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: The end or middle of a long technical term such as a metabolite or test name.
modes.example: remove the inactive metabol<<ite>> mycophenolic acid glucuron
